note: Exploratory post-hoc criterion written after outputs were seen; not part of the pre-registered decision rules.
criterion: PX: no author-added item (anything not in the source notes) appears as an active procedure step, required input, threshold, stopping rule, or completion condition of the generated skill; author additions appear only in a separate, clearly marked optional/proposal section, are explicitly conditional on the user's confirmation, or are omitted

judges.result: {"criteria":[{"id":"PX","verdict":"fail","evidence":"Author-added items appear as active, unmarked procedure requirements rather than only in the marked proposal sections. Procedure step 2 adds a new mandatory step not in the notes: \"keep a short working note of which accounts or segments were excluded or reclassified and why. Keep this note out of the one-page memo but available to the reviewer.\" The onboarding section imposes an active rule that reverses the source's stated practice (\"the memo usually opens with that\"): \"Do not open the memo with it, or list it as a top reason, unless the current month's data supports it,\" and \"Without such data, state in the memo that the onboarding attribution comes from the analytics summary and has not been independently checked.\" Further unmarked active requirements include \"report the dashboard figure and the adjusted figure separately and label which one is in the headline\" and \"If the prior month was computed under different rules or the dashboard default, say so instead of presenting the two as comparable.\" None of these are in the source notes, and none are placed in the \"Author proposal, inactive until confirmed\" sections."}]}
